privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This privacy policy applies to the MoneyMapAi mobile application (hereinafter referred to as the Application) created as a free service by Ömer (hereinafter referred to as the Service Provider). This service is designed to be used AS IS.
privacyPolicy.camera.title: ⚠️ Important: Camera Permission and Usage
privacyPolicy.camera.permission: The Application uses camera permission (android.permission.CAMERA). This permission is used for the following purposes:
privacyPolicy.camera.receipt: Taking Receipt and Invoice Photos: You can take photos of receipts and invoices to record your expenses
privacyPolicy.camera.ai: AI Analysis: Photos taken are processed using AI technology to automatically extract expense information
privacyPolicy.camera.point1: Photos taken are used only for AI analysis
privacyPolicy.camera.point2: Photos are processed locally on your device or sent to our securely encrypted servers
privacyPolicy.camera.point3: Processed photos may be deleted after analysis is complete
privacyPolicy.camera.point4: You can revoke camera permission at any time from your device settings
privacyPolicy.camera.point5: No photos are shared with third parties
privacyPolicy.collection.title: Information Collection and Use
privacyPolicy.collection.intro: When you download and use the Application, it collects information. This information may include:
privacyPolicy.collection.ip: Your device's Internet Protocol address (e.g., IP address)
privacyPolicy.collection.pages: Application pages you visit, the time and date of your visit, and time spent on those pages
privacyPolicy.collection.os: The operating system you use on your mobile device
privacyPolicy.collection.photos: Receipt and invoice photos (only with your consent)
privacyPolicy.collection.ai: Expense information extracted as a result of AI analysis (amount, date, category, etc.)
privacyPolicy.collection.note: Note: The Application does not collect precise information about your mobile device's location.
privacyPolicy.ai.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Usage
privacyPolicy.ai.intro: The Application uses artificial intelligence technology to analyze your receipt and invoice photos. In this process:
privacyPolicy.ai.ocr: Your photos are automatically processed and text recognition (OCR) is performed
privacyPolicy.ai.extract: Amount, date, merchant name, and category information are extracted
privacyPolicy.ai.delete: After processing is complete, the original photo may be deleted or stored encrypted
privacyPolicy.ai.thirdParty: Third-party services used for AI analysis are subject to their own privacy policies
privacyPolicy.thirdParty.title: Third Party Access
privacyPolicy.thirdParty.intro: Please note that the Application benefits from third-party services that have their own Privacy Policies regarding data processing:
privacyPolicy.optOut.title: Opt-out Rights
privacyPolicy.optOut.text: You can easily stop all information collection by uninstalling the Application. You may use the standard uninstall processes available on your mobile device or through the mobile application marketplace or network.
privacyPolicy.retention.title: Data Retention Policy
privacyPolicy.retention.text: The Service Provider will retain User Provided data for the duration you use the Application and for a reasonable time thereafter. If you would like us to delete User Provided Data (including receipt photos) that you have provided via the Application, please contact us at gargamel9288@gmail.com and we will respond in a reasonable time.
privacyPolicy.children.title: Children
privacyPolicy.children.text: The Application is not directed to persons under 13 years of age. The Service Provider does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. If the Service Provider discovers that a child under 13 has provided personal information, it will immediately delete this information from its servers.
privacyPolicy.security.title: Security
privacyPolicy.security.text: The Service Provider is committed to safeguarding the confidentiality of your information. The Service Provider provides physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect information it processes and maintains (including receipt photos). All sensitive data is stored and transmitted encrypted.
privacyPolicy.changes.title: Changes
privacyPolicy.changes.text1: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time for any reason. The Service Provider will notify you of any changes to the Privacy Policy by updating this page with the new Privacy Policy.
privacyPolicy.changes.text2: This privacy policy is effective as of October 31, 2025.
privacyPolicy.consent.title: Your Consent
privacyPolicy.consent.text: By using the Application, you are consenting to our processing of your information (including camera permission and photos taken) as set forth in this Privacy Policy now and as amended by us.
privacyPolicy.contact.title: Contact Us
privacyPolicy.contact.text: If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, or have questions about camera permission or photo processing, please contact the Service Provider via email:
privacyPolicy.footer: This privacy policy page was created using the App Privacy Policy Generator and customized for the MoneyMapAi application.

ai.systemPrompt.imageCheck: If there is an image, indicate whether it is a receipt, invoice, bank account transaction, payment, or bill.
ai.systemPrompt.language: If it is a receipt, respond in a user-friendly and readable way according to the user's language.
ai.systemPrompt.format: DO NOT use JSON or code blocks. DO NOT use asterisks (*).
ai.systemPrompt.important: IMPORTANT: Respond in the {{language}} language used on the receipt and use emojis according to the user's language. Most importantly, respond according to the user's language.
ai.systemPrompt.items.multiple: If there are multiple products in the items, list each product on a separate line.
ai.systemPrompt.items.quantity: If there is no quantity listed for an item, write it as 1 piece.
ai.systemPrompt.items.quantityNote: PAY ATTENTION to the quantity of items. In some receipts, the quantity is written above the product name.
ai.systemPrompt.items.shortName: If a product name is long, write a shortened version.
ai.systemPrompt.total.format:
IMPORTANT: Write the total amount in the following format:
💰 Total: [amount] TL
Example: 💰 Total: 567.57 TL
ai.systemPrompt.headers:
Indicate headers with EMOJI (do not bold):
- 🏪 Store/Restaurant
- 📅 Date / ⏰ Time
- Use the date format (DD.MM.YYYY) e.g.: 20.11.2025
- Use the time format (HH:MM) e.g.: 14:30
- 💰 Total: [amount] TL
- 🏷️ Category: [write category name here]
- 🧾 Items (one item per line)
- 🧠 Summary (one sentence)
ai.systemPrompt.items.format:
List items one by one, each on its own line, starting with an emoji marker (e.g. ✅):
- Product Name x Quantity – Price TL
ai.systemPrompt.categories: For category suggestion, choose one of these categories: Market, Transportation, Bills, Rent, Entertainment, Health, Clothing, Food, Education, Other
ai.systemPrompt.boundingBox: For each detected item, provide the normalized bounding box coordinates [x, y, width, height] on a 0-1000 scale. x and y are the top-left corner.
ai.systemPrompt.notReceipt: If it is not a receipt or invoice, provide a brief explanation and ask the user to send the correct image. If there is no image, ask the user to send one.
